metadata.analysisMethod: Measured image size 768x1280; verified exact divisibility into 12x20 cells of 64x64; confirmed non-empty content in all 240 cells; animation roles inferred from pose sequences per 6x5 character block.
warnings: Source file provided as JPEG (JFIF), not PNG. A PNG with near-white background converted to alpha was written as enemies_atlas.png for engine use. Prefer an original lossless PNG if available.
Character names are visual labels only (not official asset names).
Animation labels for local rows 0 and 1 (idle vs move) are based on visual interpretation; for some characters both rows look like walk cycles. Verify per character in-game.
Hit row (local row 3): frames 0–2 are clearly flash/hit; frames 3–5 often resemble recovery toward idle/move. All 6 sheet frames are included; trim if your engine only needs the flash.
Die row (local row 4): frame 0 is often a white silhouette flash before the fall/dissolve sequence.
frameDurationMs is unknown and set to null — set by gameplay feel (common starting point for this style: 80–120 ms).
anchor {x:0.5,y:1.0} is a conventional feet-bottom pivot for top-down sprites, not measured from the image.
No separate projectile or VFX strips exist as independent cells; archer arrow and golem ice crystals are drawn inside character attack frames.
No health, damage, speed, or other gameplay stats are included — assign those in game data.
JPEG compression may leave slight color fringing at cell edges; a clean source PNG would improve quality.
